title: Length of the Longest Alphabetical Continuous Substring
description:
An alphabetical continuous string is a string consisting of consecutive letters in the alphabet. In other words, it is any substring of the string "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
Given a string s consisting of lowercase letters only, return the length of the longest alphabetical continuous substring.
Example 1:
Example 2:
Constraints:

examples.example_text:
Input: s = "abacaba"
Output: 2
Explanation: There are 4 distinct continuous substrings: "a", "b", "c" and "ab".
"ab" is the longest continuous substring.

Input: s = "abcde"
Output: 5
Explanation: "abcde" is the longest continuous substring.

constraints: s consists of only English lowercase letters.
hints: What is the longest possible continuous substring?
The size of the longest possible continuous substring is at most 26, so we can just brute force the answer.
